description: This file defines a utility function 'makeWakeWordSegments' that processes a transcript and a list of words with timing information to produce an array of WakeWordSegment objects, establishing functionality likely related to speech or wake word processing.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of a wake word within a transcript, including text, start time, duration, and range in the transcript.

methods.name: makeWakeWordSegments
methods.description: Creates an array of WakeWordSegment objects from a transcript and list of words with timing info, aligning words to their positions in the transcript.
